summary: Tested 3 simultaneous fixes on Populus (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844). TEST A — full-chain back navigation via manual navStack: MOSTLY PASS. Chain walk (backs 1→2→3) correctly steps /user/B → /circle/D → /user/D → /circle/{me}. However the FINAL back (from /circle/{me} → expected /profile) still lands on '/' when the chain has been walked end-to-end via router.replace(), because router.replace strips the '?from=/profile' query and useSmartBack's fallback branch is never reached (router.canGoBack() returns true on web, then router.back() collapses to '/'). Direct back from /circle/{me} without walking (with ?from=/profile in URL) DOES land on /profile correctly, so profile-circle-open push path is fine — only the chain-exit case misfires. TEST B — user-circle-toggle useFocusEffect refresh: PASS. Label correctly flips AGGIUNGI→NELLA CERCHIA after add, and back to AGGIUNGI after removing from /circle/{me} then returning to /user/{X} via deeplink (useFocusEffect refetches circleStatus). TEST C — in-app confirm modal: PASS. Modal shows title 'Rimuovi dalla cerchia', body 'Rimuovere @nickname dalla tua cerchia?', ANNULLA + red RIMUOVI buttons; no browser URL header. ANNULLA keeps member; RIMUOVI removes and refreshes list. testID 'circle-remove-confirm-modal' present.

ui_bugs.issue: TEST A back-step 4 FAIL — after walking the FULL manual navStack chain (user/B → circle/D → user/D → circle/me), the final tap of circle-back on /circle/{me} lands on '/' instead of '/profile'. Root cause: each intermediate goBack() invokes router.replace(prev) which drops the '?from=/profile' query string. When the stack finally empties, useSmartBack (a) has no navStack entry, (b) has no `from` param, (c) hits `router.canGoBack()` → true on Expo web because browser history has entries, (d) calls `router.back()` which on Expo web collapses to '/'. The developer-supplied fallback ('/profile' when userId === me) is NEVER reached. Fix option: on web, prefer the `fallback` argument over `router.back()` when both navStack and `from` are empty; OR preserve/propagate the `from` param across router.replace calls; OR store the ORIGINAL entry-point 'from' at the bottom of navStack. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/useSmartBack.ts:44-61

action_items: FIX residual back-nav bug: after walking the entire navStack chain, the fallback is not honoured on web because router.back() still collapses to '/'. Recommended patch in /app/frontend/src/utils/useSmartBack.ts: swap steps 3 and 4 on web (Platform.OS === 'web' → try fallback before router.back()), OR pass the fallback through router.replace as a query param during pop navigation so the last screen always retains its 'from' hint. Test-vector: profile → circle/me → user/D → circle/D → user/B; then 4 back presses should land on /user/D, /circle/me, /profile — NOT collapse to '/' on the 4th press.

rca_of_issue: The manual navStack correctly walks step-by-step through the pushed chain of detail screens (verified: backs 1/2/3 land on the exact expected paths). However each `goBack()` invocation uses `router.replace(prev)` which DOES NOT preserve query parameters. So the very first screen in the chain (/circle/{me}), which was opened from /profile with `?from=/profile`, loses that query after being re-entered via router.replace during the popping phase. When the user presses back at the bottom of the chain, `navStack.popAndPeek()` returns undefined, `useLocalSearchParams().from` is undefined (query dropped), `router.canGoBack()` returns true on Expo web (browser history has multiple entries pushed by the earlier .push() and .replace() calls), and `router.back()` on Expo web collapses to '/'. The developer-supplied `fallback = '/profile'` is never reached. Fix: on web, prefer `fallback` before `router.back()`; OR carry the original `from` through router.replace so it always resurfaces at chain-exit.
